items.en: US ambassador calls violent Israeli settlers 'terrorists' amid West Bank unrest.

items.en: Senior Lebanese political figure opposing Hezbollah receives threats.

items.en: Gaza death toll reaches 73,651 since October 2023, health ministry reports.
